text:
Avery Singh: Hey everyone — first day at Redwood Inference! I'm Avery (they/them), joining as a Solutions Engineer based in Vancouver. Coffee snob, board game nerd, and very excited to meet y'all. I'll be hybrid (in SF office Wed/Thu). Happy to swap lunch recs or meetup suggestions :)
Riley Park: Welcome Avery!! :tada: The coffee corner on 2nd floor does a great cortado. Also, we have a casual 'game table' at lunchtime on Fridays — bring a quick game if you want.
Kai Nakamura: Hey Avery, welcome! I'm your onboarding buddy — ping me if anything's missing (repos, creds, infra access). Also, there's a tiny D&D group if you ever want in.
Jordan Price: Hi Avery — welcome to the team! If you're around Wed at noon, there's a small new-hire picnic in the courtyard, swing by and I'll save a spot. Where in Vancouver are you from?
welcome-bot: Welcome @Avery Singh! 🎉 You've been added to #new-hires and granted access to the "SE Onboarding" doc: https://redwood.company/onboarding/avery (automated)
Avery Singh: Thanks so much, everyone!! I'll bring Sushi Go for Fri lunch if that's cool :D Heads-up I'm allergic to peanuts, so safe-snack plans appreciated. I'm from Kitsilano — small beach kid turned cloud person.
Riley Park: Noted on peanuts. We usually have a couple veg/peanut-free options — perfect. Tea or coffee for you?
Jordan Price: Tea noted. See you Wed at the picnic :)
Kai Nakamura: Sent a 30m sync invite for Fri 10am with onboarding checklist and quick intro to the stack. Welcome aboard again!
